summary: John's 1st cousin 7x removed; Luzerne County Commissioner, last of the 'Davenport congress'.
bio: Stephen Davenport (1800-1882), son of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, was a Luzerne County Commissioner and lived later in Huntington Twp.
